abstract: This paper develops a model of platform liability for ex post compensation of consumer harm caused by third-party sellers. A platform chooses how liability is shared with sellers, but assumes no liability because it reduces sellers' safety investments. Mandated platform liability can increase or decrease consumer surplus: it is more likely to be beneficial when the platform has weak market power or faces competition, but less so when it sells first-party goods or third-party sellers are judgment-proof. When the platform invests in screening judgment-proof sellers, liability regulation encourages investment, increasing welfare gains. Regulations targeting only incumbents may deter platform entry.
abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个平台责任模型，旨在对第三方卖家造成的消费者损害进行事后补偿。平台选择如何与卖家分担责任，但因其会降低卖家的安全投入而不承担任何责任。强制平台责任可能增加或减少消费者剩余：当平台市场力量较弱或面临竞争时，更可能有益；但当平台销售自营商品或第三方卖家无力偿债时，则效果减弱。当平台投资于筛选无力偿债的卖家时，责任监管会鼓励此类投资，从而增加福利收益。仅针对现有企业的监管可能阻碍平台进入。
title: Should Platforms be Held Liable for Defective Third‐Party Goods?
title_zh: 平台是否应对第三方缺陷产品承担责任？

abstract: Drawing on classical insights from mechanism design, we show that ex post efficient mechanisms induce agents to make efficient ex ante investment choices if and only if they are strategy-proof. For mechanisms that fail to be exactly strategy-proof or efficient, we derive a correspondence between the degree of failure of strategy-proofness or efficiency and the degree of failure to induce efficient investment. Our results extend to settings with uncertainty. Additionally, our results imply both that the worker-optimal stable mechanism incentivizes workers to make efficient human capital investments before entering the labor market, and that uniform-price and double auctions induce approximately efficient investment in large markets.
abstract_zh: 借鉴机制设计的经典洞见，我们证明，事后有效机制能诱导代理人做出事前有效投资选择，当且仅当这些机制是策略-proof的。对于不完全策略-proof或效率不足的机制，我们推导出策略-proof性或效率缺失程度与诱导有效投资缺失程度之间的对应关系。我们的结果扩展至不确定性环境。此外，我们的发现还意味着，工人最优稳定机制激励工人在进入劳动力市场前进行有效的人力资本投资，而统一价格拍卖和双向拍卖在大市场中诱导近似有效的投资。
title: Strategy-proofness, investment efficiency, and marginal returns: An equivalence
title_zh: 策略证明性、投资效率与边际收益：一个等价性

abstract: We find that CEO compensation increases following acquisitions only in those deals in which acquirer stock is used as the method of payment. These compensation increases are driven by increases in equity-based compensation and are concentrated in riskier acquirers, in riskier acquisitions, and in acquirers whose CEOs have low exposure to the stock price. We find little support for traditional agency cost explanations of changes in CEO pay following acquisitions. However, our findings are broadly consistent with compensation changes representing a contracting solution to a two-sided adverse selection problem that is present only in stock acquisitions.
journal: Journal of Financial and Quantitative Analysis
title: CEO Compensation Changes Following Acquisitions

abstract: In a field experiment among US university students, incentives for sleep increase both sleep and academic performance. Our primary intervention pairs bedtime reminders with morning feedback and immediate rewards for sleeping at least 7 hours on weeknights. The intervention raises the share of weeknights with 7+ hours of sleep by 26% and average sleep by 19 minutes during a 4-week treatment period, with posttreatment effects of 8 minutes. Immediate incentives outperform both delayed incentives and reminders/feedback alone during treatment but have no distinguishable impacts posttreatment. The primary intervention improves average semester course performance by 0.075–0.089 grade points, a 0.10–0.11 standard deviation increase. Our results demonstrate that incentives targeting sleep can be a cost-effective approach to improve educational outcomes.
abstract_zh: 在一项针对美国大学生的实地实验中，睡眠激励措施同时提升了睡眠时长和学业表现。我们的主要干预措施结合了睡前提醒、晨间反馈以及针对工作日夜间至少睡眠7小时的即时奖励。该干预措施在为期4周的治疗期内，将工作日夜间达到7小时以上睡眠的比例提高了26%，平均睡眠时间增加了19分钟，治疗后的效果为8分钟。即时激励在治疗期间优于延迟激励及仅提供提醒/反馈的方式，但在治疗后的影响上无显著差异。主要干预措施使学期平均课程成绩提高了0.075至0.089个绩点，相当于0.10至0.11个标准差的提升。我们的结果表明，针对睡眠的激励措施可以成为改善教育成果的一种成本效益高的方法。
title: Sleep: Educational Impact and Habit Formation
title_zh: 睡眠：教育影响与习惯养成

abstract: To study long-run large-scale early childhood policies, this paper incorporates early childhood investments into a general equilibrium heterogeneous agent overlapping generations model calibrated using US data. A randomized controlled trial evaluation of a short-run small-scale early childhood program in the model predicts effects on children’s education and income that are similar to the empirical evidence. A long-run large-scale program, however, yields over twice as large welfare gains as those of a short-run small-scale program even after considering general equilibrium and taxation effects. Key to this difference is that investing in a child not only improves her skills but also creates better ancestors for future generations.
abstract_zh: 为研究长期大规模早期儿童政策，本文将早期儿童投资纳入一个以美国数据校准的通用均衡异质性主体世代交叠模型中。模型中对短期小规模早期儿童项目的随机对照试验评估预测，对儿童教育及收入的影响与实证证据相似。然而，即便考虑了一般均衡与税收效应，长期大规模项目带来的福利收益是短期小规模项目的两倍以上。这一差异的关键在于，对儿童的投资不仅提升了其个人技能，还为未来世代创造了更优秀的祖先。
title: The Macroeconomic Consequences of Early Childhood Development Policies
title_zh: 早期儿童发展政策的宏观经济后果

abstract: This paper examines how training affects productivity across hierarchical layers within organizations. After a randomized training program for frontline employees at a government agency, trained workers’ output increased while their requests for managerial assistance fell. This freed managers to focus on strategic tasks—particularly managers with the strongest connections to trained employees. A structural model of organizational hierarchy shows that spillovers to managers account for approximately 45% of the program’s total benefits, indicating that evaluations focused solely on individual trainees may substantially understate the full value of training investments.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了培训如何影响组织内各层级员工的生产力。在一项针对政府机构一线员工的随机培训项目中，受训工人的产出增加，同时他们向管理层寻求帮助的次数减少。这使管理者得以专注于战略任务——尤其是那些与受训员工联系最紧密的管理者。一个组织结构层级模型显示，对管理者的溢出效应约占项目总收益的45%，这表明仅关注个体受训者的评估可能会大幅低估培训投资的整体价值。
title: Training, Communications Patterns, and Spillovers inside Organizations
title_zh: 组织内部培训、沟通模式与溢出效应

abstract: We state a sufficient condition under which choice data alone suffices to identify consumer preferences when choices are not fully informed. Suppose that: (i) the data generating process is a search model in which the attribute hidden to consumers is observed by the econometrician; (ii) if a consumer searches good j, she also searches goods which are better than j in terms of the non-hidden component of utility; and (iii) consumers choose the good that maximizes overall utility among searched goods. Canonical models will be biased: the value of the hidden attribute will be understated because consumers will be unresponsive to variation in the attribute for goods that they do not search. Under the conditions above and additional mild restrictions, an alternative method of recovering preferences using cross derivatives of choice probabilities succeeds regardless of the search protocol and is thus robust to whether consumers are informed. The approach nests several standard models, including full information. Our methods suggest natural tests for full information and can be used to forecast how consumers will respond to additional information. We verify in a lab experiment that our approach succeeds in recovering preferences when consumers engage in costly search.
abstract_zh: 我们给出一个充分条件，在此条件下，当消费者选择并非完全知情时，仅凭选择数据即可识别消费者偏好。假设：（i）数据生成过程是一个搜索模型，其中消费者未观察到的属性被计量经济学家观察到；（ii）若消费者搜索商品j，则她也会搜索在效用的非隐藏成分方面优于j的商品；（iii）消费者在已搜索商品中选择总效用最大化的商品。经典模型将存在偏误：隐藏属性的价值会被低估，因为消费者对未搜索商品的属性变化无反应。在上述条件及额外温和限制下，一种利用选择概率的交叉导数来恢复偏好的替代方法，无论搜索协议如何均能成功，因此对消费者是否知情具有稳健性。该方法涵盖包括完全信息在内的若干标准模型。我们的方法为完全信息提供了自然检验，并可预测消费者如何响应额外信息。我们通过实验室实验验证，当消费者进行有成本搜索时，该方法能成功恢复其偏好。
title: A Method to Estimate Discrete Choice Models That Is Robust to Consumer Search
title_zh: 一种对消费者搜索行为稳健的离散选择模型估计方法
